text: 2018 marked the first year of operations for CreateTO. For the year ending December 31, 2018, CreateTO Financial results are in line with the 2018 budget of $11.4 million.

City Council on June 18 and 19, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the 2018 Annual Report in Attachment 2 to the report (April 29, 2019) from the Chief Financial Officer, CreateTO for information. 2. City Council approve the 2018 Audited Financial Statements in Attachment 3 to the report (April 29, 2019) from the Chief Financial Officer, CreateTO.
